description: Lists the issue-triage run history for one attached repo — one row per GitHub issue that was auto-triaged — including terminal status (`pr_opened` means a fix PR was opened and passed the repo's own test suite; `needs_human` means the issue wasn't judged auto-fixable; `failed` means the triage/build/verify pipeline errored). The `repoAttachmentId` is the attachment `id` returned by `list_repos`, NOT a `owner/repo` string. Full diagnostics (the generated diff and before/after test output) for any run id returned here are available via the get_triage_diagnostics tool.

repoAttachmentId.description: The repo attachment id, as returned by list_repos (not an owner/repo string).

name: get_triage_runs
